title: No moving out of a local copy of a package (2026-11-11)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: yes. You can't move out of a local copy of a package.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-11, answering ask A1 on srs-rust PR #1641 (`srs package move`): moves into or out of a package installed from a bundle are refused. Such a package is refined at its source and reaches a repository by upgrade.
